about.description:
HyperFrames renders motion graphics programmatically: compositions are a
pure function of frame index, so output is frame-deterministic and
reproducible. It ships a block catalog (code animations, transitions,
caption styles, lower thirds, social cards, data-viz, 3D device mockups),
footage-facing effects such as colour grading, grain and background
removal, and HDR10 / 4K delivery. Rendering runs locally.

This package provides the ``hyperframes`` command line interface.
about.summary: Frame-deterministic motion-graphics engine and CLI for programmatic video

raw_meta_yaml:
# yaml-language-server: $schema=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/prefix-dev/recipe-format/main/schema.json
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "0.7.72"

package:
  name: hyperframes
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  - url: https://registry.npmjs.org/hyperframes/-/hyperframes-${{ version }}.tgz
    sha256: 958a29b1908dc29d7ed6ca24f98a6fd32f4fbdef05f9f3fec6c81217c3945216

build:
  number: 0
  variant:
    ignore_keys:
      - nodejs
  script:
    - if: unix
      then:
        - export npm_config_prefix="${PREFIX}"
        - node -e "const fs=require('fs');const p=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('package.json','utf8'));delete p.devDependencies;fs.writeFileSync('package.json',JSON.stringify(p,null,2));"
        - pnpm install --ignore-scripts --prod
        - npm pack --ignore-scripts
        - npm install --no-bin-links -g ./hyperframes-${{ version }}.tgz
        - pnpm-licenses generate-disclaimer --prod --output-file=third-party-licenses.txt
        - mkdir -p "${PREFIX}/bin"
        - |
          cat > "${PREFIX}/bin/hyperframes" << 'EOF'
          #!/bin/sh
          exec "${CONDA_PREFIX}/bin/node" "${CONDA_PREFIX}/lib/node_modules/hyperframes/bin/hyperframes.mjs" "$@"
          EOF
        - chmod +x "${PREFIX}/bin/hyperframes"
        - |
          cat > "${PREFIX}/bin/hyperframes.cmd" << 'EOF'
          @call "%CONDA_PREFIX%\bin\node" "%CONDA_PREFIX%\lib\node_modules\hyperframes\bin\hyperframes.mjs" %*
          EOF
      else:
        - call npm config set prefix "%PREFIX%"
        - if %ERRORLEVEL% neq 0 exit 1
        - node -e "const fs=require('fs');const p=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('package.json','utf8'));delete p.devDependencies;fs.writeFileSync('package.json',JSON.stringify(p,null,2));"
        - if %ERRORLEVEL% neq 0 exit 1
        - call pnpm install --ignore-scripts --prod
        - if %ERRORLEVEL% neq 0 exit 1
        - call npm pack --ignore-scripts
        - if %ERRORLEVEL% neq 0 exit 1
        - call npm install --userconfig nonexistentrc -g hyperframes-${{ version }}.tgz
        - if %ERRORLEVEL% neq 0 exit 1
        - call pnpm-licenses generate-disclaimer --prod --output-file=third-party-licenses.txt
        - if %ERRORLEVEL% neq 0 exit 1

requirements:
  build:
    - nodejs >=22
    - pnpm
    - pnpm-licenses
  host:
    - nodejs >=22
  run:
    - ffmpeg
    - nodejs

tests:
  - script:
      - hyperframes --help
      - if: unix
        then:
          - test -f "${PREFIX}/lib/node_modules/hyperframes/package.json"
        else:
          - if not exist "%PREFIX%\\node_modules\\hyperframes\\package.json" exit 1

about:
  homepage: https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes
  repository: https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes
  license: Apache-2.0
  license_file:
    - LICENSE
    - third-party-licenses.txt
  summary: Frame-deterministic motion-graphics engine and CLI for programmatic video
  description: |
    HyperFrames renders motion graphics programmatically: compositions are a
    pure function of frame index, so output is frame-deterministic and
    reproducible. It ships a block catalog (code animations, transitions,
    caption styles, lower thirds, social cards, data-viz, 3D device mockups),
    footage-facing effects such as colour grading, grain and background
    removal, and HDR10 / 4K delivery. Rendering runs locally.

    This package provides the ``hyperframes`` command line interface.

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - rxm7706
